tags.name: Ørnehøj Golfklub
tags.note: Really does have 27 holes - consists of 3 9-hole 'subcourses' played as 1 18-hole course (2 subcourses) and 1 9-hole course (1 subcourse), with grouping of the subcourses rotating weekly. V. https://www.ornehojgolfklub.dk/baneguiden/
